column1: Every video-synthesiser knob and what moves it

This is the patch. Each row is one parameter of the signal chain, what drives it, the exact formula in the code, and what it does to the image. Rows marked MANUAL are not yet driven by anything - they are free knobs waiting for a channel. Write the channel you want in the yellow column.

column6: how high the terrain rises. The single most legible parameter: a loaded machine is literally mountainous.
how far the past recedes. Higher = deeper tunnel, rows bunch at the back.
the hard threshold on warm/cool ratio. Lowering it lets AMBER through - memory pressure literally changes the colour of the world.
horizontal shear on the raster, the way a dropout sheared analogue video. Fires on real fault events only, then decays.
brightness gain before the key. Pushes more of the image over the bloom threshold.
how separated the lines are. Fewer lines = more gap = more obviously a video synth.
keeps true black empty, so the image has real voids instead of grey wash.
how long a trail survives. Above ~0.97 the image never clears and goes to mush.
per-frame scale of the previous frame. This is what makes tunnels.
per-frame rotation. Combined with zoom it makes logarithmic spirals.
where the zoom converges. Currently the CPU node - the machine's centre of gravity.
density on a bus IS its throughput. The core honest mapping.
a busy bus moves faster, not only denser. Authored, not measured.
